Neither is heavier — they weigh exactly the same. A kilogram is a unit of mass, so a kilogram of feathers and a kilogram of steel both have the same mass, regardless of the material. The trick in this classic riddle is that people intuitively think of "heaviness" in terms of density or how bulky something feels, but weight and density are different concepts.
